results.title: Hyderabad Metro Phase II Stays on Paper
results.description:

Compared with other Indian cities, Hyderabad has not added a single kilometre of new [...]HYDERABAD: Hyderabad's Metro Rail expansion has made little progress, with the proposed Phase II network remaining confined to official proposals. The lack of coordination between the Centre and the Telangana government has delayed fresh Metro construction, leaving commuters waiting for years.

Compared with other Indian cities, Hyderabad has not added a single kilometre of new Metro construction in the past eight years. As a result, the city has slipped to ninth place nationally in Metro network development, though it continues to rank fifth in operational services.

City slips in Metro expansion despite operational strength

The first phase of the Hyderabad Metro Rail project, covering 72 km across three corridors, was launched in 2012. Construction was completed in November 2017, making Hyderabad the country's second-largest Metro network after Delhi at the time.

While several other Indian cities have since moved ahead with second- and third-phase Metro expansion projects, Hyderabad has seen no further construction. The Telangana government has repeatedly urged the Centre to approve new Metro corridors to meet the city's growing transport needs. However, approvals have reportedly been delayed because of deficiencies in the Detailed Project Report (DPR) and technical issues.

As a result, Metro operations continue only on the existing routes.

1,100 daily services operate on existing corridors

After the first phase became operational in November 2017, Metro services began running on all three corridors. At present, around 1,100 Metro services operate every day on these routes, carrying an average of 4 lakh to 4.8 lakh passengers daily.

results.title: Austin light rail chooses manufacturer, transportation expert weighs in
results.description: Austin Transit Partnership (ATP) announced that it has chosen Stadler to manufacture its CityLink rail vehicles for Austin's light rail.
